dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon bless you. What brings you to the Cathedral today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, you are...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: I'm Seamus Pegg, Seneschal of the Church of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: If there's anything you need to confess or if you need help with, I'm always here to listen.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon bless you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think I've seen you before...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: That is indeed so. I was on Grand Master Varka's expedition.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: It was only recently, as the conflict in Nod-Krai drew to a close, that I was finally able to return to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: All these years, the Church of Favonius has continued to function only through the diligence of our priests and sisters. Therefore, I intend to share as much of the load as I can from now on, so that everyone can rest more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you are Jean and Barbara's...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Yes, Jean and Deaconess Barbara are my daughters.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon forgive my negligence. As their father, I should have shouldered more responsibility for them.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: But our Deaconess is always so incredibly diligent that she won't even let me help her out. And Jean... her temperament is perhaps too much like her mother's.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: So... All I can do is pray to the Anemo Archon. May His grace lighten their burdens, if only by a little.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Knight. What brings you to the Cathedral today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lohen asked me to drop off a report...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Lohen? Submitting a report before the deadline? Truly a marvel of our time... Let me take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Hmm... The handwriting is quite neat, and the phrasing is very precise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong? Or is the report satisfactory?

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Nothing's wrong, aside from the fact that it's obvious Lohen didn't write a word of it. Ten to one, he outsourced this to Gunther or Ursula.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Still, at least he turned it in on time for once, and it looks like he actually bothered to check it himself... I won't say any more.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: I only hope Grand Master Varka and Lord Barbatos can find it in their hearts to excuse him, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Varka and Barbatos, you say...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Knowing them... They'll let it slide.
